hospital.name: San Gorgonio Memorial Hospital
hospital.snippet: Our emergency department at San Gorgonio Memorial Hospital (SGMH) is located on the eastern end of the hospital, with its entrance on Memorial Drive West, off of North Highland Springs, in Banning, California.

police.name: Banning Police Department
police.snippet: The Banning Police Department is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year to serve the needs of our growing city.

court.court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Riverside
court.serves_note: Serves Banning and surrounding areas for civil, criminal, traffic, domestic relations, juvenile, mental health, and probate matters
court.snippet: The Banning Justice Center is located in southeast Riverside County and is a three level building that houses six courtrooms
